verdict.tagline: Classic grinding and steep subscription walls meet jarring technical inconsistencies.
for_you_if: you enjoy deep progression loops in classic MMORPG worlds
you do not mind relying on external guides for quests
not_for_you_if: you require standard WASD movement controls
you want access to content without a paid subscription
you are put off by mixed visual asset styles

claims.claim: Reviewers report that game content, skills, and activities are restricted unless players purchase a membership subscription.

citations.review_text: over 90% of this games playable content is locked behind a pay wall. A majority of each classes abilities are locked behind a pay wall. Don't bother investing time into necromancer, crafting and upgrading necromancer gear is locked behind a pay wall. corporate greed is inescapable and this game is a waste of time. This game is "pay to enjoy"

They got too greedy with the monetization. I liked this game up until the last year when they got rid of the free and earnable daily lottery spins (100's of hour on the official RS launcher). They said it was to avoid giving certain players an unfair advantage that took away from the achievements of those who grinded.... And then they added experience you can straight up buy for cash directly. Also the vast majority of content (>90%) is behind the membership paywall. 

There's no point in playing anymore if you aren't paying, because leveling up your skills becomes even more of a grind with only the free options. I won't lie, I would pay for it when they had the lottery spins because each day I had my challenges to motivate what I would do and I enjoyed it. Now without that, I just don't have the reason to consistently get on which means I'm also not making any progress since at the high levels you need consistent commitment to get anywhere. Also, I don't want to reward scummy practices.

RIP to a game I loved since my childhood. Don't waste your time getting into it. So many better things to do.

citations.review_text: here is a perspective from someone who didnt play as a kid and wanted to try the game. Most of the games content, in the form of new entire chunks of the map are behind this subscription. Meaning you can explore a sliver of what the games has to offer as a free to play player. There are even skills and gear you cant craft unless you are a member. Additionally even if you are in a area that isnt locked to you, there are even quests there locked behind paywall. Despite being a ancient game from 99 they have the nerve to ask for $15 a month for the subscription. This is the greed they talk about in the bible. If this game had come out today exactly how it is now, this game would be crucified. Everything feels dated which is fine but $15 is way too high. i wouldnt even consider it until it was in the $5-$7 range, this game is not world of warcraft and the fact that they believe that they bring the same amount of content as WoW to justify the membership cost sickens me.

Not Recommended

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game requires consulting external guides like the RuneScape Wiki because in-game explanations and quest progression are cryptic or lacking.

citations.review_text:
If you love sandbox RPGs with massive depth, this is an absolute gem.

The Free-to-Play portion gives you a ridiculous amount of content for zero dollars. What I love most is the freedom: combat is only as much of a focus as you choose it to be—you can easily spend hours focusing entirely on crafting, mining, and working the market instead.

It took me around 100+ hours of gameplay to reach the final F2P quest, so you definitely get your time's worth. The game systems can be confusing at first, so keep the RuneScape Wiki open whenever you get stuck!

10/10 sandbox freedom.

I know there are a lot of people who enjoy Runescape but after 28 hours of playing I honestly cannot see it.
Its extremely grindy and tedious, Quests are boring and the game suffers from poor quest structure and ingame aid Also you don't have a way to filter members only quests out if you are a free to play adding more frustration to it.
I had to constantly look up things on the wiki simply because of a lack of clear explanations, also even the most basic materials are an absurd grind. 
I tried out Magic and quickly came to the realization that unless you find a staff with magic infuused with an element you will have to grind to the point where you get frankly sick of it. 
At low level Air is something you can get with relative ease but the moment you try to get Water essence you are out of luck because you need a Water talisman to get it. So you figure its something you should be able to craft once you have the level right? Wrong, the water talisman is a drop either by a enemy you will not have the level to beat at that point or you need to purchase it at the runecrafter guild which you can only access at runecrafting 50 and then you also need the special currency which is yet another grind.
All this does is frustrate and discourage people doing mage because warrior is way easier to grind and make gear for.
Ranger has similar problems but not as severe as the mage.
There are more things but its honestly pointless to mention its a miserable experience and I could not find any fun out of it.
This is of course just my take but I would not recommend this if you have only limited time to play each week and want to spend the few hours you have with something fun, because you will in all likelyhood not find it here.
Only issues is that finding the items to complete quests is very cryptic and difficult for a new player...
